verdict.rationale: The release notes mention 'GPT Live in meetings and calls' as a shipped feature, hinting at some live voice interaction capability, but there is no documentation describing voice-note transcription, text-to-speech replies, or how live voice conversations work within the messaging channels (WhatsApp, Telegram, etc.). missing for 10: dedicated voice/audio docs, voice-note transcription support, spoken-reply/TTS capability, and confirmation that live voice conversations work across the standard chat channels rather than just 'meetings and calls'.
